# Version 4.154.0
> **m154 and documentation** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.154.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.400/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.154.0 previews Skia m154 and delivers compiler XML documentation with updated HarfBuzz bindings. HarfBuzzSharp now follows the bundled native source during generation. Code using the corrected combining-class enum name needs a small source update.

## Breaking Changes

- **UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 was corrected to CCC132** — The upstream name is now reflected in HarfBuzzSharp while preserving numeric value 132. Replace source references to CCC133 with CCC132.
- **GlyphFlags.Defined is no longer available** — Aggregate Defined masks are not exposed because they are not independent options. Combine the concrete glyph flags required by your code instead.

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m154** — Updates the bundled renderer to Chrome milestone 154 and incorporates current upstream bug and buffer-upload fixes. ([#4945](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4945), [#5054](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5054), [#5114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5114))

## API Surface

- **Compiler XML documentation shipped with packages** — Package consumers receive compiler-generated XML documentation sourced from C# API comments. ([#5053](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5053), [#5064](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5064), [#5066](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5066), [#5078](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5078), [#5080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5080), [#5091](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5091))
- **HarfBuzz bindings generated from bundled source** — Keeps HarfBuzzSharp bindings synchronized with the HarfBuzz revision used to build the bundled native library. ([#5056](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5056), [#5057](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5057))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.400

HarfBuzzSharp now generates bindings from the DEPS-pinned native source and corrects the CCC132 enum name while keeping unsupported callback-heavy APIs out of the managed surface.
